Highlights: Family-owned business with over 18 years of local experience. Frequently ranked as a top overall roofer in Miami for customer satisfaction, quality installations, and extendable warranties.
What Makes a Roof "Hurricane-Rated" in Miami?
In Miami-Dade County, roofs must adhere to High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) standards. A true hurricane-rated or hurricane-resistant roof assembly requires a layered approach rather than a single product: All Phase Construction USA +1
Miami-Dade NOA (Notice of Acceptance) Materials: Products tested and approved to withstand extreme wind pressures.
Sealed Roof Deck: Taped or sealed plywood joints to prevent water intrusion if the outer covering fails.
Secondary Water Barrier: An underlayment layer that protects the interior even if shingles or tiles blow off.
Enhanced Fasteners: Ring-shank nails or screws spaced and installed per strict code density guidelines. All Phase Construction USA
Average Cost: Impact-resistant, hurricane-rated roof replacements in Miami typically range from $30,000 to $38,000 installed, depending on the size of the home, pitch, and material choice (shingle, metal, or concrete tile). Modernize Home Services
